title: Helios composite
description: A composite saved as a file of its own (<id>@<version>.helios-composite.json): a sub-network packaged as one node, the inner parameters it exposes and the panel that edits it. See docs/templates.md.

id.description: Stable: lowercase words of letters and digits joined by '.' or '-'.

version.description: Templates pin it; a newer one is offered, never taken silently.

nodes.description: In order: a node reads the composite's inputs (from '@') and nodes before it.

layout.description: What the channels mean: rgba, y.

params.description: Parameter values by name, tagged by kind, as in template.json.

from.description: An inner node, or '@' for the composite's own inputs.

exposed.description: An inner parameter made the composite's own, in the order shown; one name on several inner nodes links them, its interface given on the first entry. The fields after 'param' are optional: the inner parameter's own otherwise.

label.description: A short label, in English; the name otherwise.

group.description: The section it is shown under; sections keep the order of their first parameter.

min.description: Narrows the inner hard range of a number or a list of numbers, never widens it.

max.description: Narrows the inner hard range of a number or a list of numbers, never widens it.

soft.description: The range a slider spans by default, within the hard range: [low, high].

options.description: The options a choice keeps, in the order shown: a subset of the inner ones.

default.description: The default, tagged by kind as a node's parameters ({ "float": 0.5 }); the inner node's value otherwise.

workshop.description: Experimental: what makes the macro a workshop, its intent and the relative targets its exposed parameters are aimed at on each image. See docs/design/workshops.md.

intent.description: What it is for, in English.

keywords.description: English words it is found by.

targets.description: At most one per exposed number parameter, solved in this order.

target.description: What the image should measure, and the exposed parameter moved to get there.

measure.description: luma.median and luma.high (the 99th percentile) in stops around 1.0, clip.high (the share of pixels above 1.0) in %.

value.description: In the measure's unit; with at: input, an offset from what the input measures.

at.description: Where it is measured: the workshop's output (the default) or its input.

panel_hint.description: Which panel edits it and where that panel docks; a template's node may override it.
